verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an official MCP server that users connect to their AI assistant via OAuth. Once connected, the assistant "acts as you" and can see and do whatever your workspace role allows, so the product can be driven through natural-language requests to that assistant. Fieldwork also takes a plain-language control description and has AI agents collect the evidence. However, the docs never list which actions or tools the MCP server exposes, and there is no natural-language interface inside the product itself. missing for 10: documented list of MCP tools/actions and their coverage of platform operations, a native in-app natural-language command interface, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
